One page per task. These pages predate the planned standard task report,
which will give every task the same sections: forms and deployment,
coverage, the item bank, item health, scores, reliability and validity,
efficiency, and open issues. Until then, analyses of Hearts & Flowers, Math,
Same & Different, Stories, ROAR-Word and ROAR-Sentence are in
[Studies](../studies/index.qmd).
